properties.title: Simulating clinical interventions with a generative multimodal model of human physiology

properties.version_basis: PDF identified by SHA-256 against assignments.json; title page read.

properties.description: Generative multimodal physiology model with intervention-conditioned simulation checked against a prospective nutrition trial and published randomised trials.
Decoder-only transformer over 667 tokenised measurement modalities, queried with appended intervention tokens for paired control and treatment simulations on real or synthetic populations.

properties.algorithm: 139M-parameter decoder-only transformer with next-token objective over 13,056 value and category tokens

properties.decision: hypothesis generation and risk stratification, not individual decisions

capability_assessments.rationale: Held-out prediction is evaluated and intervention tokens condition predictions with paired control and treatment arms compared against published trials, which meets L2. L3 is not claimed because the authors state the model learns associations from observational data and is not a counterfactual or causal engine, and synthetic populations replace trial participants. Core membership holds because token history is carried into each prediction with learned temporal dynamics.

Held-out prediction is evaluated and intervention tokens condition predictions with paired control and treatment arms compared against published trials, which meets L2. L3 is not claimed because the authors state the model learns associations from observational data and is not a counterfactual or causal engine, and synthetic populations replace trial participants. Core membership holds because token history is carried into each prediction with learned temporal dynamics.

gate_assessments.rationale: Hash-based participant splitting, training-only HPP bin boundaries, and participant-disjoint external cohorts are implemented, but feature availability times are not reported (data.availability_time), zero-shot external tokenization re-aligns bins using each external cohort's empirical CDF (p. 39), and PNP3 shares ascertainment/device conventions with the HPP research group (p. 40).

Carried participant history (state.persistent), time-indexed transitions (dynamics.temporal), and held-out within-visit and ~2-year V1->V2 predictions (rollout.one_step_evaluated) are evaluated on 3,217/1,364 held-out HPP participants and UKBB/PNP3, outperforming LOCF (68.3% of modalities) and per-modality linear regression (62.7% overall; 51/57 significant modalities, Fig. S2).
Forecasting is a single query about two years ahead and monthly queries are not rolled out, so no horizon error curve exists.
Only a token count rule exists and synthetic populations include covariate combinations absent from training, with no overlap analysis.

legacy_cells.B: Simulating clinical interventions with a generative multimodal model of human physiology
legacy_cells.C: Lutsker, Guy, Sapir, Gal, Merino, Jordi, Shilo, Smadar, Godneva, Anastasia, Meirom, Eli, et al.
legacy_cells.O: Human physiology trajectories and multiple incident diseases and mortality outcomes, including cardiovascular, metabolic, respiratory, renal, and neurological conditions
legacy_cells.S: Can a multimodal longitudinal model forecast an individual's future physiology and produce intervention-conditioned biomarker predictions that agree with observed or trial-reported outcomes?
legacy_cells.AI: Continuous and categorical clinical measurements, blood biomarkers, body composition and DEXA, ECG, ultrasound, sleep physiology, wearable-derived physiology, continuous glucose monitoring, diet, exercise, medications, gut microbiome, RNA and genetic principal components, metabolomics, questionnaires, retinal features, vascular measures, and demographics
legacy_cells.AJ: Decoder-only transformer with learned token, modality, temporal, continuous-value, positional, and age/gender embeddings
legacy_cells.AM: Element-wise additive embedding fusion followed by causal self-attention across the unified time-ordered sequence
legacy_cells.AN: No imputation. Unmeasured modalities are absent from the participant token sequence and augmentation trains on incomplete profiles
legacy_cells.AS: 768-dimensional transformer hidden states and 768-dimensional pooled participant embeddings
legacy_cells.AX: In held-out PNP3, mean correlation increased from r = 0.39 with baseline-only context to r = 0.64 with CGM, diet, and interim clinical measurements
legacy_cells.BD: Medication and exercise category tokens, dietary and sleep-value modifications, intervention timing, token frequency and duration, and clinical dosing frequency
legacy_cells.BF: Treatment-naive indication and baseline/control-prediction biomarker thresholds were used to determine eligibility
legacy_cells.BL: CGM measurements approximately every 5 minutes, repeat HPP visits approximately 2 years apart, and monthly intervention queries over 12 months
legacy_cells.BS: Full probability distributions and expected-value predictions for queried future physiological measurements across 667 modalities
legacy_cells.BT: Autoregressive next-token prediction and downstream penalized Cox survival, ridge biological-age, and logistic-regression readouts on pooled embeddings
legacy_cells.BV: Gaussian-smoothed cross-entropy, normalized mean absolute error, and split-context longitudinal next-token loss
legacy_cells.BX: 15,319 Human Phenotype Project participants and 64,223,972 tokens
legacy_cells.BY: 139,171,612 trainable parameters in the final model
legacy_cells.CA: Training used 8 NVIDIA H100 80GB SXM GPUs. Inference used 1 NVIDIA RTX 4090 24GB GPU
legacy_cells.CD: Approximately four years in the individual longitudinal visualization
legacy_cells.CV: No causal identification method or assumptions stated. The authors characterize predictions as associational and not causal
legacy_cells.DN: Human Phenotype Project (HPP), UK Biobank (UKBB), National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES), Personalised Nutrition Project 3 (PNP3), and Framingham Heart Study
legacy_cells.DQ: HPP: 15,319 participants; UK Biobank: 502,244; NHANES: 29,458; PNP3: 200; Framingham: 4,434
legacy_cells.DX: Longitudinal V1-to-V2 prediction at approximately two years had mean Pearson r from 0.25 for ultrasound to 0.65 for anthropometric measures, with 330/338 modalities significant. In PNP3, predicted-versus-observed six-month changes included BMI r = 0.63, fasting glucose r = 0.61, and diastolic blood pressure r = 0.78
legacy_cells.EB: Intervention-conditioned predictions agreed with the reported effect direction in all 41 RCT comparisons and fell within the published 95% CI in 30/41. Twelve-month trajectories showed dose-ordered predicted responses for walking frequency and caloric restriction
legacy_cells.ED: Held-out PNP3 predicted versus observed six-month biomarker changes correlated at r = 0.49 to 0.89 across ten biomarkers. Trial-level predicted effects were compared with published RCT estimates
legacy_cells.EG: Training hardware and inference hardware were reported. Inference was run on one RTX 4090 GPU with batch size 1, sequentially per patient
legacy_cells.EI: Compared with last observation carried forward and per-modality linear regression for longitudinal prediction, and age + sex + BMI and established clinical risk scores for survival prediction
legacy_cells.EL: Under-prediction of high-dose semaglutide and high-potency statin effects, over-prediction of ramipril blood-pressure and selected off-target SGLT2/GLP-1 effects, and nonsignificant individual HDL prediction in PNP3
legacy_cells.EO: Data were de-identified prior to model development and analysis
legacy_cells.ER: HPP participants gave written informed consent and the study protocol was approved by an institutional review board. External datasets were accessed under appropriate data-use agreements and ethical approvals
legacy_cells.FB: A unified chronological sequence of discretized measurement/event tokens with modality, value, timestamp, and demographic embeddings; the transformer produces 768-dimensional contextual hidden states
legacy_cells.FL: Tokenization maps multimodal measurements and timestamps into a shared sequence. A 14-layer decoder-only transformer maintains contextual hidden states and predicts modality- and time-conditioned token distributions. Expected-value outputs support forecasts and intervention queries, while pooled embeddings feed separate downstream risk and biological-age readouts. No planner is implemented
legacy_cells.FM: The authors introduce HealthFormer, a generative decoder-only transformer trained on deeply phenotyped longitudinal physiology, and evaluate forecasting, external transfer, risk prediction, and intervention-conditioned biomarker predictions
legacy_cells.FN: The model transferred to four independent cohorts and improved prediction over age + sex + BMI for 27/30 UK Biobank endpoints. In held-out PNP3, six-month biomarker changes were predicted with correlations up to r = 0.89. Across 41 RCT comparisons, predicted direction agreed in all and point estimates fell within published 95% CIs in 30
legacy_cells.FO: The authors state that observational training yields associational rather than causal predictions. They note imperfect and sparse longitudinal prediction, synthetic trial-matched rather than original RCT populations, coarse intervention representation of dose/adherence/titration/discontinuation/indication/timing, and discretized rather than continuous high-frequency or mechanistic physiology
legacy_cells.FP: The authors propose prospective randomized calibration and expanded prospective evaluation, external validation against future trial readouts, endpoint-specific causal-inference designs, richer dose and adherence tokens, and denser physiological measurements
legacy_cells.FQ: Prior models either represented episodic clinical records without dense physiology or rich physiological measurements without whole-person temporal dynamics
legacy_cells.FR: Action-conditioned predictions and agreement with published trial estimates do not establish causal treatment effects or individual counterfactual efficacy. Trial comparisons use synthetic matched populations, and the paper reports no prospective deployment, planner, or clinical utility outcome
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M3 Belief-state service; M4 Action service; M5 Dynamics adapter; M7 Outcome & causal layer
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Pass the paper’s specified action and time context explicitly into the state-transition interface; preserve the boundary between predictive action sensitivity and identified intervention effects.
legacy_cells.FX: Complete extracted PDF text reviewed across pp. 1–108, including title page and abstract, introduction, main Results and Figures 1–6, discussion and limitations, Methods, data and ethics, intervention simulations, supplementary methods, tables, and supplementary figures. Relevant main-text and supplementary result tables were inspected. Some supplementary tables have disrupted row/column alignment in the extracted text; ambiguous table values were not used. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: A:I left untouched because the PDF did not directly contradict the prefilled fields. The paper demonstrates intervention-conditioned association and forecast evaluation, not causal identification, a clinical decision planner, or prospective utility. Some extracted supplementary tables have disrupted alignment. The 12-month intervention trajectories are query-based predictions and do not demonstrate feedback rollouts. Evidence QA: 89/97 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (91.8%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 94 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 4 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. notes: HealthFormer is a 139M-parameter decoder-only transformer over 667 tokenised measurement modalities trained on 12,102 HPP participants. It reconstructs and forecasts held-out measurements, transfers zero-shot to four external cohorts and predicts individual six-month changes in a held-out nutrition trial (r 0.61 to 0.78 for three biomarkers). Intervention-conditioned simulations on synthetic trial-matched populations agree in direction with 41 published comparisons and fall within the published interval in 30. The authors state the model is associational and not a causal engine. Classified L2, core, R3. Source points: absolute-value effect formula, 43 versus 41 comparison counts, statin intensity not represented.
